rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 1993). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 1993).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S in 2002 as 'Royal Copenhagen'.
Introduced in New Zealand by Rasmussen's Ltd. in 2015 as 'Remember'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Strong fragrance. Borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or exhibition.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 15,195 on 28 Sep 2004 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 10/738,877 on 16 Dec 2003
Inventors: Olesen; L. Pernille (Fredensborg, DK), Olesen; Mogens N. (Fredensborg, DK)

The present invention constitutes a new and distinct variety of garden rose plant which originated from a controlled crossing between the female parent, an unnamed seedling, and the male pollen parent `POULduce` .... The two parents were crossed during the summer of 1993
rows.Notes:
From the Hortico web site: "Beautiful light pink to almost white; high-centered, double blooms with good form; dark green shiny foliage (Poulsen 2002)"
